messages:
alex.sales: Heads-up — Acme (pilot) asked if we can onboard and pin a new open model for them: llmax-7b (quantized) in eu-west-1 + ap-southeast-1. Need pinned version, quantized variant, and an SLO of ~200ms p95 for chat use. They want a contract demo next quarter.
maya.product: Thanks Alex — do we have the exact model artifact / repo link from the upstream? also any customer data residency constraints?
alex.sales: They provided a tarball and a HuggingFace link in the ticket. No customer data will leave region. It's a business-critical pilot so they want predictability.
nora.ml: quick check: llmax-7b appears to have fp16/pt weights and a community quantized (int4) fork. We'll need to verify correctness of int4 kernels on our runtime and perf profiles for 2k context.
rajesh.eng: @nora.ml +1. Primary risk is quantization compatibility with our current kernel set. We also need to confirm memory footprint vs. nv4/asis targets. If they require 200ms p95 -> might need dedicated capacity in those regions.
sam.infra: eu-west-1 and ap-southeast-1 have limited spare reserved GPUs this quarter. We can provision Dedicated if they commit a short term reserved pool. Planner: estimate required qps?
alex.sales: They're targeting 50 qps peak for the demo, lower sustained. Open to dedicated reserved for pilot.
nora.ml: With int4 we can likely hit token latency targets on A10G-ish hardware for short contexts, but we should run a quick perf matrix. Can we get samples and prompts?
maya.product: Scope question: do we treat this as "catalog onboarding + pin + geo availability" or as an escalated enterprise onboarding (legal/KMS/compliance)? If data never leaves region and they sign DPA, treat as catalog + pin with Dedicated offer.
rajesh.eng: For product checklist: model license review, quantization verification, model verification tests (output parity/regression harness), perf bench, rollback plan (fallback to unquantized), and config for pin + routing.
ops-bot: Incident reminder: provisioning Dedicated capacity in ap-southeast-1 can take ~7 business days for GPUs.
maya.product: Launch criteria proposal: 1) quantization perf within 20% of baseline latency; 2) no critical hallucination/regression on our eval prompts; 3) infra capacity reserved for pilot; 4) signed pilot contract. Thoughts?
alex.sales: Agreed. Sales will push for contract asap. Can product try to move prioritization? This is a strategic customer.
rajesh.eng: Proposed next steps: - eng to run perf matrix (int4 vs fp16) on representative prompts - infra to check capacity and cost for 50 qps - ML to run regression eval suite - product to confirm legal/license. I'll need a ticket with artifacts and sample prompts.
maya.product: I'll create intake ticket and add checklist. Alex, please drop the HF link + sample prompts into the ticket.
alex.sales: done — ticket link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/ENG-12345 (file: hf.com/llmax-7b; samples attached).
nora.ml: Running quick smoke: sample prompt returned reasonable outputs locally but we need end-to-end batch perf. Will post numbers within 48h.
sam.infra: I confirmed limited spot capacity in ap-southeast-1; recommend Dedicated reserve for pilot or fallback routing to eu-west only for early demo.
maya.product: Decision: prioritize as P1 catalog entry for pilot with the following scope — pin v1.3-quant, enable region eu-west-1 for demo, evaluate ap-southeast-1 Dedicated feasibility; rollback to v1.3-fp16 if quant fails. I'll mark in roadmap and ping eng.
alex.sales: :thumbsup: I'll communicate timeframe to customer — expect an update in 72h.
rajesh.eng: I'll open ENG ticket and tag eng-runtime + eng-infra. Blockers: if community quant uses custom ops we may need to vendor or recompile kernels.
nora.ml: FYI test config snippet I'm using:```
model: llmax-7b
version: v1.3-quant
context: 2048
batch_sizes: [1,4,8,16]
regions: [eu-west-1]
metrics: latency_p50,p95,mem_peak
```
maya.product: Thanks everyone — keeping this thread as single source. Revisit when perf numbers and infra ETA are in.
ops-bot: Reminder: add legal review when onboarding external model artifacts."
